verdicts.reason: A keeps a sensible left-to-right flow (can in its circle, then brand and headline, then body copy, then badges), but the CTA has been shrunk into a small dark circle that overlaps both badges and sits against the right edge, and its 'Find It Near You' label is tiny and cramped, so the main action is buried. B is broken: the can has been pulled out of its backing circle, leaving an empty green disc on the far left and a tiny can stranded on the right. The SOLSTICE wordmark has dropped below the headline, the body copy is illegibly small, and the CTA is a small pill crammed into the same row as the badges, with large dead areas around everything.
